# Vamp

> Vamp currently promotes two open-source, local-first products: Vamp
> Assistant and Vamp Stream. Use a trusted LAN or private Tailscale network;
> every new device requires visible approval and there is no hosted relay.

Website: https://thevamp.app/
Assistant: https://thevamp.app/assistant/
Stream: https://thevamp.app/stream/
Suite source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite
Assistant source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-assistant
License: Apache-2.0

## Public products

- Vamp Assistant: native macOS AI chat, local/BYOK models, Code workspaces,
  specialist bots, browser/simulator tools, and approval-gated automation. Its
  own iOS app and browser Remote Sessions endpoint provide private remote use.
- Vamp Stream: focused iPhone/iPad visual client. It connects to Vamp Host or
  the supporting Vamp Sync companion over signed WebRTC, or to Vamp Assistant
  through its authenticated private Remote Sessions endpoint.

Vamp Sync is presented only as a Stream host option. Vamp Host, Control,
Terminal, Terminal Host, Browser control as a standalone product, and Linux
Host are not in current public promotion. Their source and specialist technical
documentation remain intact.

Never expose host ports directly to the public internet. Never approve a peer
whose identity was not verified independently.
